ChatGPT said:

Your script is genuinely well engineered already.

The biggest improvement you asked for is easy:

  • make 1080p the default when pressing Enter.

Right now your menu() function forces explicit numeric input, so Enter does nothing.

The cleanest fix is to add default-choice support to the menu function.

Replace your current menu() function with this improved version:

Bash
menu() {
    local msg="$1"
    local default="$2"
    shift 2

    local -a opts=("$@")
    local pick i=1

    printf '%s?%s %s\n' "$B" "$R" "$msg" >&2

    for o in "${opts[@]}"; do
        if (( i == default )); then
            printf '   %s%d)%s %s %s(default)%s\n' \
                "$CYN" "$i" "$R" "$o" "$D" "$R" >&2
        else
            printf '   %s%d)%s %s\n' \
                "$CYN" "$i" "$R" "$o" >&2
        fi
        ((i++))
    done

    while true; do
        read -r -p "  > " pick

        [[ -z "$pick" ]] && pick="$default"

        if [[ "$pick" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] &&
           (( pick >= 1 && pick <= ${#opts[@]} )); then
            printf '%s\n' "${opts[$((pick-1))]}"
            return
        fi

        warn "pick 1-${#opts[@]}" >&2
    done
}

Then change your resolution section from:

fmt="bv*[vcodec^=av01][height<=${height}]+ba[acodec^=opus]/bv*[height<=${height}]+ba/b"

This:

Bash
sanitize() {
    printf '%s' "$1" |
    sed 's#[/:*?"<>|\\]##g' |
    tr -s '[:space:]' '_' |
    cut -c1-100
}

)

echo " URL : $url"
echo " Mode : $mode"

echo " Section : $start → $end"

echo " Resolution : ${height:+≤${height}p}"
echo " Codec pref : AV1 + Opus"
echo " Container : MKV"

if [[ ${#downloader_args[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
echo " Downloader : aria2c (16 connections)"

echo " Downloader : native"
fi

[[ -n "$COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER" ]] &&
echo " Cookies : $cookies_resolved"

echo

confirm "Proceed?" || {

exit 0
}

info "Downloading..."

yt-dlp \
"${cookie_args[@]}" \
"${downloader_args[@]}" \
-f "$fmt" \
-S "codec:av01,res,fps,hdr:12,acodec:opus" \
--merge-output-format mkv \
--embed-metadata \
--embed-thumbnail \
--embed-subs \

"${sec_args[@]}" \

"$url"

ok "Saved → $outfile"
